experiment: Extension: broader microscopy dataset with Poisson bucket noise (MedMNIST+ BloodMNIST and PathMNIST, 64x64)
relation_to_other_work: separate experiment. The onion study (FREEZE_MANIFEST_phase1_phase2.md5) and the noise-free extension (outputs/extension_medmnist_microscopy/FREEZE_MANIFEST_extension.md5) are read-only and checked before/after. Same images, pattern seeds, DGI, U-Net, recipe and pass rule as the noise-free extension; the only change is Poisson noise on the bucket values.
claim_scope: fewer simulated measurement shots under simulated Poisson bucket noise at three relative levels; the photon scale is set per image to fix the RELATIVE noise level, so no photon-dose, biological-effect, hardware or quantum claim. Noisy DGI-10000 is a study-specific benchmark, not ground truth.

data.splits: MedMNIST official train / val / test (PathMNIST test = CRC-VAL-HE-7K, a different centre from its train/val NCT-CRC-HE-100K)

noise.model: B' = Poisson(s * B) / s on every bucket value B = sum(P * x); reference arm R = sum(P) noise-free
noise.photon_scale: s = 2 sum(x) / (f^2 sum(x^2)) per image, so noise std ~= f * sigma_B, sigma_B = 0.5 sqrt(sum(x^2)) = spread of the noise-free bucket over Bernoulli(0.5) patterns
noise.noise_rng: default_rng([acquisition seed, 1000003, round(100 f)]), drawn shot by shot (nested prefixes)
noise.pre_check: f = 0 reproduces the frozen noise-free extension pool exactly (max abs diff 0.0, 3 spot checks); measured noise std / sigma_B = 0.0499 / 0.0997 / 0.2994 (blood image) and 0.0498 / 0.0997 / 0.2993 (path image)

simulation.nesting: DGI-N uses the first N shots of the same 10,000-shot sequence

training.images: 7,000 training images (3,500 blood + 3,500 path); one model per noise level and N (12 models)
training.target: original clean object (models AI-original-N, as the noise-free extension's clean target). No DGI-10000-target models: with noise the 10k DGI is itself noisy.
training.input: noisy DGI-N of the same level
training.sequences: pool of K = 32 sequences per training image, pattern seeds as the noise-free extension; one realisation per image per epoch via default_rng([0, epoch])
training.selection: 1,000 validation images x shared sequences [2040, 2041, 2042] at the same noise level; checkpoint = lowest selection MSE vs clean object

evaluation.test_pairs: 2,000 test images x 4 sequences = 8,000 per noise level
evaluation.comparator: noisy DGI-10000 of the same acquisition and noise level
methods: smoothed noisy DGI-N (Gaussian sigma per level and N minimising MSE vs the clean object on training pool k = 0, 1; grid final_evaluate.SIGMAS)
evaluation.context: noise-free DGI-10000 of the same pattern sequence, and AI-original-N minus noise-free DGI-10000 (secondary, reported with the same rule)
metrics: edge r (Pearson r of Sobel magnitude maps)

criterion.definition: on paired image-level differences [metric(method) - metric(comparator)] pooled over seeds 2026-2029, the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples over images, seeds kept together, rng default_rng(0) per group) is >= -0.02 for SSIM AND >= -0.01 for Pearson r
criterion.minimum_N: smallest N in {500, 1000, 2000, 5000} meeting the criterion; reduction factor = 10000 / N
criterion.secondary: blood and path separately (same rule, images of that subset only)
criterion.candidates: AI-original-N and smoothed DGI-N, each vs noisy DGI-10000, separately per noise level

order_of_work: validation per level -> freeze checkpoints (MD5) and sigmas in results/level_*/frozen_for_test.json
single test evaluation per level (script refuses a second run)
deviations_from_noise_free_extension: Poisson bucket noise at three relative levels (the purpose of this experiment)
pools store N = 500..5000 only (10k not needed as a training input)
pattern batches of 100 instead of 500 (identical pattern stream; consecutive generator draws)
smoothed-DGI baseline tuned against the clean object (not the 10k DGI)

seeds.patterns: identical to the noise-free extension (pool, selection, evaluation) so the noise is the only change
